scope: Bounded exact exposure inventory for all eight consumed IntAct publications, all their MITAB primary participant/pair views and complete identity-qualified XML evidence aliases; four previously recorded historical publication anchors and DOI aliases. Not a complete inventory of historical CIViC, Pharos/STRING, literature, datasets, sequences or model pretraining.
article_status_scope: Reuse only previously recorded PubMed ESummary metadata; no new correction/retraction/republication lookup, article/full-text audit or clearance. Missing alerts are unknown. No new article or publication-status query in this expansion.

exposure_semantics: Exact literal source database+accession identities. Primary participants and unordered MITAB pair views reuse unchanged helpers, with original side orientation retained separately. No synonym, sequence, isoform, species or biological-context collapse. XML evidence aliases include only MI:0356 or IMEx MI:0662; generic see-also/method refs are not identity. XML local experiment IDs stay source-scoped. Shared participants/pairs alone do not prove shared experiments or exclude a study.
publication_semantics: Only eight selected consumed PMIDs and preexisting historical anchors enter consumed publication_ids. New DOI aliases require matching selected publication identity and source-qualified DOI references. Other citations/see-also remain scoped references, not automatically consumed studies or evidence of data reuse.
compatibility: Uses existing v1 inventory field schema for frozen provenance_audit compatibility, with inventory_revision2 and additional source-scoped details. No frozen helper or original inventory changed. Complete alias inventory does not widen a future auditor automatically; its query semantics must be separately frozen.
limitations: No independent biology, source-fidelity score or graph improvement is established by an exposure inventory.
Publication DOI aliases may be absent from captured XML; missing aliases are not proof of disjointness.
No full-text, correction/retraction/republication review or complete historical dataset audit.
Unknown provider lineage and external evidence/sequence/proteoform equivalence remain unresolved.
MITAB expanded pair views and XML n-ary evidence objects remain different units, not independent experiments.
A local experiment XML ID cannot match across files without a supplied global reference.
